title: Source activity 1: Perpendicular bisector
instruction: A line that bisects a segment and is perpendicular to it.

title: Source activity 2: Equidistance property
instruction: Points equidistant from segment endpoints lie on its perpendicular bisector.

title: Source activity 3: Angle bisection
instruction: Equal-radius constructions create congruent triangles and halve an angle.

title: Source activity 4: Copying an angle
instruction: Transfer an arc and its chord to construct a congruent angle.
